theme: An open Halloween with the girls — and a board backlog to clear before tomorrow's review.
greeting: The day is yours, Dan — no meetings, four kids, and trick-or-treating tonight. Tomorrow the girls head back to Jen and you and Mike sit down for the 15-minute board review, so today is the window to make the holiday-trip calls that have been waiting.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike — 9 AM
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 15-minute board review (9 AM, Mike organizing) is the forcing function for the backlog below. Arrive having skimmed the Mike + Dan board, ready to put an owner and a date on each stalled item.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Flagged p1 on the Mike + Dan board, overdue since Sept 14. A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the thinnest inventory in that market and it sells out — the one that genuinely costs money to leave another week.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board, p2 — both its windows (decide by Sept 30, book by Oct 15) have passed. All four kids, Dec 13 – Jan 2; the call between a domestic shortlist and flexible international bookings still hasn't been made.

flagged.title: KLA — VP, Global Government Affairs & Strategic Policy
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn job alert surfaced this role, squarely in your governance and public-affairs field. Automated alert, not personal outreach.

inbox.noise: The rest is promos and newsletters — SoFi, Mattress Firm, Hulu, Harry & David, Hyatt, Epoch Times and Press Herald — plus two off-target LinkedIn alerts.
inbox.clear: No urgent, security, financial, or personal mail awaiting a reply.

recipe.title: Roast Venison Fillet
recipe.why: Autumn is game season, and a quick-roasted fillet suits the first real cold of the year.
